limits: Wording and reference checks only; no semantic, relevance, historical or cognacy validation. Pointing/accents are normalized; roots, inflections, orthography, segmentation and named witnesses require review. Qere is separate from the WLC ketiv text. Unmatched spans are findings, not automatic rejection; a match does not verify a connection.
